statement: ∃ mu : LR.T p M v →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ, ∀ q c, mu (q ⊗ₜ[LR.R p] c) = (q : ℂ) * (c : ℂ)
proof:
letI : IsScalarTower (LR.R p) ℚ ℂ := ⟨fun r q c => by
  change (((r : ℚ) * q : ℚ) : ℂ) * c = ((r : ℚ) : ℂ) * ((q : ℂ) * c)
  simp [mul_assoc]⟩
set_option pp.all true in
let mu : LR.T p M v →ₗ[ℚ] ℂ := TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.lift (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℚ ((LR.Jc p M v) →ₗ[LR.R p] ℂ) (LR.Jc p M v).subtype)
exact ⟨mu, fun q c => rfl⟩
